# Under P2 and P4 the own class has a least form

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`the-least-own-class` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](the-least-own-class.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where a member conditions something and some class meets P2 and P4 at it, the class of the member with everything downstream of it meets both and lies within every class that does; such classes meet, and each gives the member's line the same reach.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The downstream class of a member: the member and everything downstream of it alike, every other occurrence alike only to itself; it is a class and holds the member's effects. (`Becoming.OwnClass.downstreamClass`, `Becoming.OwnClass.downstreamClass_class`, `Becoming.OwnClass.downstream_of_alike`, `Becoming.OwnClass.downstream_step`, `Becoming.OwnClass.downstreamClass_held`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. Where the member conditions something and some class meets P2 and P4 at it, the downstream class meets P2 there and lies within every class meeting both; under P2, holding the member's effects is containing it. (`Becoming.OwnClass.alike_of_downstream`, `Becoming.OwnClass.downstreamClass_least`, `Becoming.OwnClass.downstreamClass_constant_at`, `Becoming.OwnClass.held_iff_contains_downstream`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. Two classes meeting P2 and P4 at a member that conditions something meet in a class meeting both. (`Becoming.OwnClass.meet_class`, `Becoming.OwnClass.meet_held`, `Becoming.OwnClass.meet_constant_at`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. Under every class meeting P2 and P4 at a member that conditions something, the member's line reaches exactly what lies downstream of it. (`Becoming.OwnClass.reach_iff_downstream`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. Where whether each occurrence conditions anything is decided, the one meets P2 and P4 at every member, so the least class exists outright. (`Becoming.OwnClass.one_constant_at`, `Becoming.OwnClass.one_held`, `Becoming.OwnClass.least_own_class`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The root: any carrier, relation and class; P2 is constancy up to the net's end at the member's class, P4 holding the member's effects.
- The member conditions something; and either some class meets P2 and P4 at it, or whether each occurrence conditions anything is decided.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That P2 and P4 hold for anyone's class: the crux of the path past one's own end.
- That the downstream class is anyone's own.
- What else a class meeting both holds alike to the member, which bears on what a line reaching such an occurrence carries on.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

## Evidence

Written by an AI and checked against the Lean by its author; no person's review recorded. Short laws, none new as mathematics. Near-definitional: under P2 holding the member's effects is everything downstream being alike (constancy-read-at-a-members-class); what is added is that the class of exactly that meets P2, so a least exists, and that two such classes meet in one.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

AI reading: the least class is 07 §4.7's widest self, everything one conditions, so under P2 and P4 the de se question does not change what one's own line reaches, and the crux is whether one's class contains that class. An AI reading had conjectured that such classes close only under joins, with two whose meet fails; that is false.
